content: Jisas ri hipache le rini ni sembe wu ha nambwe
O sumbu hinga humbusiwani Jisas Galili mapwa kumbwa ya ri ichiꞌuchanda. Rini Jutiya mapwa tokwe ri i ki ri diyahandau. Hinde wowani, o ki dau Juta hima kupu le rini yeni si kinani wu hambwandawani.
Ka gisi ki Juta hima kupu lei gisi laka foti, ka hinga wu uchandau, Nikaꞌari Ba Kiro Gisi Laka, ya takai.
Wowani ri hipache le ya rini sawe, “Mini do ko ma hanjaꞌaisini Jutiya mapwa ki ma ini sumbu fwele mi wowa mi himache le wu heini sa wu hambwa.
E, hima fori hima lei miyaningisopo ki amwei ri da kinawa, rini sumbu fwele yanini ri wosinda nambwe. E, dele sumbu hinga mi wosindau ti nawa, dele himiyama hurahama i miyaningisopo ki amwei ma eti.”
Ri hipache le okwe rini ni sembe wu ha nambwe. O keke ka mwanji hinga ti wu sawero.
Ete wowani Jisas ya wunu sawe, “Ani ai gisi mwe naha ti ta nambwe. Dele gisi hinga o kui gisi mwe naha tumbwa.
Do nuwe ki dau himiyama hurahama le hinde apa kunu omwemendi kumbwa. Wunu ani numbwa wu omwemendindau. Hinde wowani, wu wosindau kapwa sumbu wuhi ni amwei wunu a sawendau ti keke.
Kunjenga ma ku ini gisi laka kuhi ti ku hei. Ani o gisi laka kuhi ti hinde apa ani inehei kumbwa. Hinde wowani, gisi mwe naha ahi ti ta nambwe.”
O mwanji hinga wunu ri sawesini rini Galili mapwa ki ya ri da.
Jisas Nikaꞌari Ba Kiro Gisi Laka hei ki iro
Jisas hipache le ka gisi laka wu hei kinani wu isiwanimbwa, rini okwe ya i. Woro ri iro ti, amwei ri i nambwe, gainani ri iro.
Wondawani Juta hima kupu le o gisi laka ki rini ni wu wakindani ya wu sawe, “Kari hima soki dau?”
Wondawani ele himiyama hurahama rini keke mwanji miyafo ki ya wu anambwanda. Ete wondani fwele sawe, “Rini hima kipe.” Wowani fwele sawe, “Mina, rini himiyama hurahama leni ri gambolombondau.”
Woro wunu ele Juta hima kupu le keke wu akindani wunu forito mwanji rini ni sawe nambwe.
Ka gisi laka i nindo ki Jisas Gotri aka laka ki ri rarusini ele himiyama hurahama ni Gotri mwanji ti ya wunu ondiyakandiyanda.
Wondawani Juta hima kupu le wu apapanani ya wu sawe, “Hinde wowani dori hima ka hambwa laka ri hambwandau? Rini sukul ri wo nambwe.”
Wowani Jisas ga mwanji wasa ka hinga ya wunu sawe, “Do mwanji kunu a sawendau ti, o ai mwanji mina. O ri ani humbwewani a taro hima ri ri mwanji.

E, hima fori Gotri okokona tini ri sirina ki ri hambwandau ti, rini apa do a sawendau mwanji mu mwe ti amwei naha ka hinga ri hambwakonda: Do a bwandau mwanji ti, Gotri to sawero mwanjiꞌi, ai inakahambwa mwanji ni a bwandau.

Hima fori mwanji fwele ri inakahambwa ki ri bwandau ti, o hi rihi tini ri rasai ki ri wondau. E, hima fori rini humbwewani ri taro hima ri hi ni ri rasai ki ri rawa, rini sumbu mwe naha tini sirinandau hima, gambondau sumbu fo rini ki da nambwe.
“Imbihumbwa Moses Gotri lo mwanji ni kunu ha nambweꞌe? Woro kui nindo ki hima fori o Gotri lo mwanji ni sirinanda nambwe. Bwele mu keke ku ani yeni si ki ku anakwendau?”
Wowani ele himiyama hurahama mwanji wasa ka hinga ya rini sawe, “Himamwale kapwa fo mini ki o da. Namoto mini yeni si ki anakwendau?”
Ete wowani Jisas ga mwanji wasa ka hinga ya wunu sawe, “Ani kwambu chele tau fo a wosiwani kunu tinda ete ku apapanaro.

Moses hima tape kupu kutondau sumbu tini kunu sawendiriro. Mwe naha, do hima tape kupu kutondau sumbu rini ki sira nambwe. O rini ni mwaseni sukwaro metele hima nuhi ki siraro. O keke apa kundo himati gisi ki kui che leni hima tape kupu ti ku kutondau.

Kunu Moses lo mwanji ni kipe naha ku sirina kinani ku hambwandau, wosini himati gisi ki kui che leni hima tape kupu ti ku kutondau. Woro himati gisi ki ani okwe o hingambwa hahungo hima forini kipe tumbwa ai rini a wosisiwani bwele keke sembe enge a ti ku ani andau?
Apa miya ki nimba hei hei hima i sumbu ti kili kei. Ele mwaꞌambwe ki dau sumbu tinda ete kipe naha ma hambwasini pwe mi bwe kili.”
Jisas rini Kuraisiꞌi?
Wosiwani Jerusalem ko kipe himiyama hurahama fwele ya wu sawe, “Ele hima rini yewa ri ha kinani wu anakwendau hima mwe ri kari toꞌo?
Wo ma hei to! Mwanji ti hima wausindau apweli ki ri bwandawani wunu ga mwanji wasa foti rini wu sawenda numbwa. Mekupu hima ele mwe naha wu hambwandau poꞌo, rini Kurais?
Woro nunu nu hambwanda, dori hima ri taro ko minde rihi ti. E, Kurais tano gisi ti, hima fori ri taro ko minde rihi ti hinde apa ri hambwa kumbwa.”

Jisas Gotri aka laka we ki ri dani ele hima ni Gotri mwanji ti wunu ri ondiyakandiyandani ri uchani ka hinga ya ri sawe, “Ani ku ani hambwani ko minde ahi ti okwe o ku hambwanda! Woro anjenga ai okokona ki a ta nambwe. Ani humbwewani a taro hima ri, ri sumbu ti mwe naha. Woro kunu rini ku hikisandau.
Ani rini ani hambwanda. Ani rini ga a daro tito ri ani humbwewani a taro.”
O keke rini toroꞌinji kinani ya wu anakwe. Woroti ri gisi mwe ti ta nambwe. O keke hima fori tapa ti rini owe nambwe, mina.

Ele himiyama hurahama lei nindo ki hima miyafo sembe ti rini ni wu hasini ya wu sawe, “Kurais tano gisi ki kwambu chele sumbu ambwe sumbu ambwe miyafo naha ri woni dori hima wosindau kwambu chele sumbu leni ri dikinoꞌo?”
Jisas ni toroꞌinji kinani apungwandai kicha hima fweleni wu humbwero

Farisi hima le wu mendiwani ele hima miyafo Jisas ri wosiro kale sumbu hinga leni ya wu bwanda. Wowani puris hima i apukolaka lenga Farisi hima lenga ori hima ni toroꞌinji kinani apungwandai kicha hima fweleni wu humbwewani ya wu i.
Jisas ya sawe, “Gisi faiche naha kunu ga a dasini ani humbwewani a taro hima ri tambwa ya ani ai ikonda.
Wosiwa ku ani wakini hinde apa ku ani hei kumbwa. Wondani o a dano ko ki hinde apa ku ta kumbwa.”

Ete wowani Juta hima kupu le wunjenga ka hinga ya wu anambwanda, “Ka so mapwa naha ki ri isiwa hinde apa rini nu wakini nu hei kumbwa? Ka nui hima kupu le Girik lei ko leki hima kicha hinga wu dau ki ri ini Girik hima leni ri ondiyakandiyakondauꞌu?
Ka ete ri sawero ti, ‘Apa ku ani wakini hinde ku ani hei kumbwa,’ wosini ka hinga ete ri ai sawero ti, ‘Kunu a dano ko ti hinde apa ku ta kumbwa,’ woro kapi mwanji mu mwe ti hinde hinga?”
Himamwale ga dau uku

Ka gisi laka i gisi jipe ti gisi omwesika naha. Woro o gisi ki Jisas saini etisini ka hinga ri uchani ya ri sawe, “E, hima fori uku sumbwe hi tinga rini saiwa, ori hima ani tambwa sa ri tani uku sumbwe ti sa ri a.
Dohaꞌa mwanji Gotri chengi ki ka hinga sawesindau: Hima fori sembe ani ni ri hano ti, himamwale ga dau uku ti ri sembe ki ete sukwani elendano.”

Jisas ka mwanji hinga ri sawero ti, Gotri Himamwale ni ri sawero. Rini ni sembe haro hima le ka Gotri Himamwale ni waya o wu torokonda. Ka gisi ki hima le Gotri Himamwale tini wu toro nambwe, hinde wowani, Jisas ri ai saini hi omwesika ri toro nambwe ri dawani.
Himiyama hurahama le nerimbe fisi wu huwaro
Wowani himiyama hurahama fwele o mwanji ni wu mendini ya wu sawe, “Mwe naha, dori hima rini ka Gotri mwanji bwarakarano hima to do tasinda.”
Wondawani fwele sawe, “Rini Kurais.” Ete wowani fwele ya wu sili, “Hinde, Kurais to ka Galili mapwa ki takondauꞌu?
E, Gotri chengi ete sawero, Kurais rini Defit hima kupu fo hinga imbihumbwa Defit daro ko, Betelehem, ko ki sukwano.”
O hinga wu bwa bwa nerimbe fisi ya wu huwa.
Hima fwele rini toroꞌinji kinani wu woro ti, hima fori tapa rini toro nambwe.
Mekupu hima le Jisas ni sembe wu ha nambwe
Ete wosiwani apungwandai kicha hima le, puris hima lei apukolaka le, e, Farisi hima le tambwa ya wu ai i. Wowani ya wunu sawe, “Hinde wowani rini ku rata nambwe?”
Ete wowani apungwandai kicha hima lenga mwanji wasa ka hinga ya wu sawe, “Imbihumbwa hima fori, kari hima bwandau mwanji hinga bwa nambwe.”
Wowani Farisi hima lenga ya wu sawe, “Rini kunu okwe kunu gamboroꞌo?
Nunu mekupu hima lenga Farisi hima lenga, ku heiwani nunu fori rini ni sembe nu haroꞌo?
Mina. Woro kale himiyama hurahama Gotri lo mwanji wu hikisandau. O keke Gotri wunu wosiwani huruhumba naha wu sirasindau.”
Wowani Nikotimas, imbihumbwa Jisas tambwa iro wui hima kupu forito ya wunu ri sawe,
“Ka nui lo mwanji hima ni nindumwasari nomo rini nu ha ki nunu ohounaroꞌo? Mina. Ri mwanji ti nu mendini ri wosiro sumbu ti norukweni nu hambwasini pwe.”

Wowani wunu ga mwanji wasa ti ka hinga ya rini wu sawe: “Wo mini okwe Galili hima foriꞌi? Gotri chengi ti ma norukweni heini hambwa. Gotri mwanji bwarakarandau hima fori Galili mapwa ki hinde sukwa kumbwa.”
